SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, KEY_1 AS QUOTATION_NO, KEY_2 AS BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM FM.MROSENDINFO WHERE DOC_NAME = 'RE' AND KEY_10 IN (' ','X')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KBRC' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, ISNULL(B.STATUS,' ') AS STATUS, REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),B.ADD_DATE,25),'-','') AS ADD_DATE_1, A.KEY_1 AS QUOTATION_NO, ISNULL(B.QUOTATION_SEQ,' ') AS QUOTATION_SEQ, ISNULL(B.REVISION_NO,' ') AS REVISION, ISNULL(B.BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, ISNULL(B.DESCRIPTION,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, ISNULL(B.SPECIFICATION,' ') AS SPECIFICATION, ISNULL(B.UNIT_MEASURE,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, ISNULL(B.MAKER_NAME,' ') AS MAKER_NAME, ISNULL(B.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS PREV_UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(B.REQ_USER_ID,' ') AS ADD_USER_ID, ISNULL(B.REQ_USER_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, ISNULL(B.REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT, ISNULL(B.REQ_USER_TELNO,' ') AS REQ_USER_TEL, REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),B.RD_DATE,25),'-','') AS ADD_DATE, ISNULL(B.ITEM_QTY,0) AS ITEM_QTY, ISNULL(B.REMARK,' ') AS REMARK, ISNULL(B.BUYER_ITEM_CODE,' ') AS REF_IF_NO FROM FM.MROSENDINFO A, FM.V_FMMATREQINFO B WHERE A.DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND A.KEY_10 IN (' ','X') AND A.KEY_1 = B.QUOTATION_NO AND A.KEY_2 = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND A.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.BUYER_ITEM_NO$' ORDER BY A.KEY_1 , B.BUYER_ITEM_NO
UPDATE FM.MROSENDINFO SET KEY_10 = 'D', KEY_9 = GETDATE() WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND KEY_10 IN (' ','X') AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.BUYER_ITEM_NO$'
